attributes.title: Widespread website outage due to server resource overload following recent deployment
attributes.summary: The incident reported by Purvai Nanda indicates a significant website outage affecting almost all customers, triggered by a resource overload likely caused by the last deployment. Initial actions included checking Datadog for anomalies and rolling back the recent deploy, which successfully restored access to the website. Purvai is tasked with updating the incident summary and drafting an internal leadership update, while Aaron began drafting a customer communication to inform them of the situation. The team will continue to monitor the situation and plans to conduct a post-mortem to prevent future occurrences.

attributes.summary: The website experienced a significant outage affecting nearly all customers, attributed to a resource overload likely caused by a recent deployment. Purvai Nanda, the incident commander, coordinated the response, which included checking system monitors and initiating a rollback of the recent deploy. Customer communications and internal updates were drafted to inform users and leadership about the issue, and after successfully rolling back the deployment, the website was restored. The team plans to conduct a post-mortem to analyze the outage's cause and prevent future occurrences.

attributes.title: Sensible Eloquence
attributes.summary: An incident, rated with severity level 1 (SEV1), occurred and is still active. The incident was reported by Andre King on September 17, 2025, at 8:37:19 AM PDT. So far, no Commander, Executive Sponsor or Postmortem Owner has been assigned. There are several tasks that are still open, including updating the incident summary, sending out customer communications, assigning roles, and updating the status page. There are no scheduled follow-ups at this time. Two members, Jamie and Andre, joined the incident channel shortly after its creation. Despite being reported, no time has been logged towards detection, acknowledgment, mitigation, or resolution of the issue.
